function move()
 if npc:npc(2909,3) then
 local q=npc:question()
 if q and npc:hasReply(25128) then npc:reply(25128) end
 q=npc:question()
 if q then print("PROBE question="..tostring(q.messageId)) for i,id in ipairs(q.replies or {}) do print("PROBE reply="..tostring(id).." text="..tostring((q.replyTexts or {})[i])) end end
 npc:leaveDialog() end
 return false
end
